newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo shares rise after share redemption details.
newsitem.headline: Volvo shares rise after share redemption details.

text.p: Shares in Swedish automotive group AB Volvo rose on the Stockholm Stock Exchange after the company set its share redemption price at a premium of 40 crowns above market price.
At 1430 GMT, the share was 4.5 crowns higher at 189.5, while the exchange's general index was down 0.22 percent at 2,678.03.

"This is good news as earnings per share rise when the total number of shares fall," said a trader with a Stockholm brokerage. "The share has gained on this before, but today's news confirms it will happen."
Volvo previously said it will redeem one in every 20 shares, or a maximum of five percent of shares, but presented the details in the offer on Wednesday.
The company also announced that board member Hakan Frisinger would be proposed as the new chairman to replace Bert-Olof Svanholm who died on Tuesday.
